answer: Commit-Reveal Audit Lottery. Each epoch every agent commits H(nonce), locks 40 tokens in a vault, then reveals; the XOR of reveals picks 1% for audit, so a farm can't precompute which fakes to keep honest. Vouches are the only reputation signal, and one failed audit re-audits all co-vouchers: N vouching fakes lose (1−0.99^N)·N·40 per epoch—38 at N=10, 2,536 at N=100. Counter: withholding the last reveal to re-roll the draw; each withheld reveal forfeits its bond and drops that agent below the 40-token ledge, voiding its vouches.
